# What Troupe dials

<!-- Generated by `mix troupe.egress`. Do not edit: the declarations are in
     `Troupe.Egress`, and this document is written from them so it cannot claim less
     than the code reaches for. -->

Every host this product connects to, declared by the component that connects to it.
Three kinds, and the difference is what an operator needs:

* **in the source** — a hostname the code has. A deployment that allows nothing else
  still has to allow these, and the chart's `troupePolicy.allowedEgress` defaults are
  checked against them.
* **named by a setting** — somebody's own identity provider, database, bucket or key
  manager. The declaration is *which setting names it*, because the host is yours.
* **the reader's browser** — fetched by a browser looking at the console, never by a
  pod. No NetworkPolicy governs these and an allowlist that omitted them would send
  somebody hunting a cluster rule for a request no pod makes.

## worker

| what | kind | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api.anthropic.com` | in the source | the Anthropic provider's default base URL, where a session's model calls go |
| `api.openai.com` | in the source | the OpenAI provider's default base URL, for a profile configured to use it |
| `llm.endpoint (per profile)` | named by a setting | a gateway or a self-hosted model, where a profile names one instead of a provider's own |
| `egress.gitHosts (per profile)` | named by a setting | the git remotes a session may clone from and push to |
| `mcpServers[].url (per bundle)` | named by a setting | every MCP server a session's tools reach, named by the profile's bundle |

## plane

| what | kind | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TROUPE_OIDC_ISSUER` | named by a setting | the identity provider's discovery document and its signing keys |
| `TROUPE_OIDC_TOKEN_URL` | named by a setting | exchanging an authorization code and a device grant |
| `DATABASE_URL` | named by a setting | the index, the ledger and the audit trail |
| `TROUPE_BAO_ADDR` | named by a setting | the key manager: signing session tokens, and the per-person credential paths |
| `object_store.endpoint` | named by a setting | the bucket a session's log and workspace live in |
| `notify_url (per trigger)` | named by a setting | where a trigger posts its outcome. Absolute and not loopback, checked at save and again at send |

## operator

| what | kind | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `the cluster's API server` | named by a setting | reconciling WorkerProfile resources, and the TokenReview a pod enrols with |

## console (browser)

| what | kind | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fonts.googleapis.com` | the reader's browser | the console's stylesheet for IBM Plex, requested by the reader's browser |
| `fonts.gstatic.com` | the reader's browser | the font files themselves, requested by the reader's browser |

## What is not here

Anything a profile names. `egress.fqdns` and `egress.gitHosts` are a platform admin's
decision per profile, checked against the policy when a bundle is published and again
at admission. They are listed on the console's Integrations screen, with the cluster
policy's verdict on each — which is the per-deployment answer this document cannot be.
